cases.input: A Python AST checker crashes on a same-name class and async parameter annotation. Current inspection shows scope lookup skips the asynchronous function because its node is absent from the function-scope classification.
A checker reports AttributeError on Module.parent, but its public reproduction, classifier owner, and runtime policy are not known.
Async functions are already correctly classified as function scopes. The failure comes from missing child-parent links in a separately constructed AST.
The interpreter rejects asynchronous function syntax before AST checking begins.
